privacy.title: Privacy that stays legible.
privacy.description: How Flash Kit handles information on its public surface.
privacy.intro: This starter policy describes the principles for Flash Kit’s public surface. It is intentionally concise and should be expanded with product-specific details before any production data collection begins.
privacy.collectionBody: The public pages do not ask for account or payment information. If a future feature collects information, Flash Kit will explain what is needed, why it is needed, and how long it is kept before that feature is used.
privacy.useBody: Information is used to provide the requested product experience, protect the service, and communicate changes that matter. It is not used to build a hidden profile of your activity.
privacy.sharingBody: Flash Kit does not sell personal information. Service providers may process limited information only when they are needed to operate an explicitly requested feature. Questions or requests about personal information should have a clear contact path in the product that collects it.
privacy.changesBody: When this policy changes, the effective date and a plain-language summary will be shown here. Continuing to use a feature after an update means the updated policy applies to that feature.

terms.title: A small set of useful boundaries.
terms.description: The public terms for using the Flash Kit surface.
terms.intro: These starter terms describe the expectations for using the public Flash Kit surface. Product-specific terms, pricing, and agreements belong with the product feature that introduces them.
terms.useBody: Use Flash Kit lawfully, respect other people, and do not interfere with the availability or security of the service. The public surface is for understanding the product, not for probing systems or submitting information that does not belong to you.
terms.contentBody: The public pages are provided as a changing product introduction. They may be updated, moved, or retired as the product develops. Nothing here promises that a future capability is already available.
terms.ownershipBody: Flash Kit and its original content remain protected by applicable rights. Feedback is welcome when it is shared through an identified product channel; it should not include confidential information that you do not have permission to share.
terms.changesBody: If these terms change, the current version and effective date will be shown here. Questions should be directed through the contact route provided by the product.
